low_power_modes_summary.idle_channel: When no messages are sent on a channel, *_valid stays LOW and the channel is quiescent. Power-aware signal encoding minimizes toggling on inactive channels.
low_power_modes_summary.cross_domain_adapter: Power-domain crossings require a TileLink-to-TileLink adapter that acts as slave in one domain and master in the other. Both interfaces of this adapter can be safely powered, clocked, and reset separately.
low_power_modes_summary.spec_invariant: It is forbidden for one side of a TileLink link to power down while its opposite is powered on. A crossing must coordinate so that no inflight requests are present when one half is reset or depowered, otherwise the bus could deadlock if a message is lost.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning, voltage-domain crossings, power-gate sequencing, isolation cells, retention registers are deferred to the SoC integration spec (UPF / CPF). The TileLink spec only defines protocol-level rules for the TileLink-to-TileLink adapter that bridges power / clock domains.

evidence.quote: It is forbidden for one side of a TileLink link to power down while its opposite is powered on. If TileLink must cross between power or clock domains, a TileLink-to-TileLink adapter is needed which acts as a slave in one domain and a master in the other domain.
Some of the important features of TileLink include power-aware signal encoding.
